"""
Project Title: Cross-Modal Vision-Language Embedding with CLIP-style Model in Keras (ai-ml-ds-CLIP2025)
File Name: vision_language_clip.py

Short Description:
Implements a CLIP-like dual-encoder model in Keras:
- A Vision Transformer (ViT) encoder processes images.
- A Transformer text encoder processes captions.
- Both produce embeddings aligned via contrastive learning.
Trained jointly on Flickr8k (downloaded within code).
"""

import os  # type: ignore
import numpy as np  # type: ignore
import tensorflow as tf  # type: ignore
from tensorflow.keras import layers, Model, Input  # type: ignore
import tensorflow_datasets as tfds  # type: ignore

# ----------------------------
# Hyperparameters
# ----------------------------
IMG_SIZE: int = 224
PATCH_SIZE: int = 16
NUM_PATCHES: int = (IMG_SIZE // PATCH_SIZE) ** 2
EMB_DIM: int = 512
NUM_HEADS: int = 8
TRANSFORMER_LAYERS: int = 6
MLP_DIM: int = 1024
TEMP_INIT: float = 1.0
BATCH_SIZE: int = 32
LR: float = 1e-4
EPOCHS: int = 10

# ----------------------------
# Utility Layers
# ----------------------------
class PatchEncoder(layers.Layer):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.proj = layers.Dense(EMB_DIM)
        self.pos_emb = self.add_weight("pos_emb", (NUM_PATCHES, EMB_DIM))

    def call(self, img):
        patches = tf.image.extract_patches(
            images=img,
            sizes=(1, PATCH_SIZE, PATCH_SIZE, 1),
            strides=(1, PATCH_SIZE, PATCH_SIZE, 1),
            rates=(1, 1, 1, 1),
            padding="VALID",
        )
        patch_dims = patches.shape[-1]
        x = tf.reshape(patches, [-1, NUM_PATCHES, patch_dims])
        return self.proj(x) + self.pos_emb

def build_transformer_encoder():
    inputs = Input((None, EMB_DIM))
    x = inputs
    for _ in range(TRANSFORMER_LAYERS):
        x1 = layers.LayerNormalization()(x)
        attn = layers.MultiHeadAttention(NUM_HEADS, EMB_DIM // NUM_HEADS)(x1, x1)
        x = x + attn
        x2 = layers.LayerNormalization()(x)
        mlp = layers.Dense(MLP_DIM, activation="gelu")(x2)
        mlp = layers.Dense(EMB_DIM)(mlp)
        x = x + mlp
    return Model(inputs, x, name="TransformerEncoder")

# ----------------------------
# Vision Encoder (ViT)
# ----------------------------
vit_input = Input((IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE, 3))
x = layers.Rescaling(1.0 / 127.5, offset=-1)(vit_input)
x = PatchEncoder()(x)
txt_cls = layers.LayerNormalization()(x)
txt_cls = layers.GlobalAvgPool1D()(txt_cls)
vision_emb = layers.Dense(EMB_DIM)(txt_cls)
# ----------------------------
# Text Encoder
# ----------------------------
tokenizer = tfds.deprecated.text.Tokenizer()
encoder = build_transformer_encoder()
# caption input
text_input = Input((None,), dtype=tf.string)
tokens = tokenizer(text_input)
# dummy mapping for example
one_hot = tf.one_hot(tokens[:, :32] % EMB_DIM, EMB_DIM)
text_x = encoder(one_hot)
text_cls = layers.GlobalAvgPool1D()(text_x)
text_emb = layers.Dense(EMB_DIM)(text_cls)
# ----------------------------
# Similarity and Model
# ----------------------------
norm_v = layers.Lambda(lambda x: tf.math.l2_normalize(x, axis=1))(vision_emb)
norm_t = layers.Lambda(lambda x: tf.math.l2_normalize(x, axis=1))(text_emb)
logits = layers.Lambda(lambda x: tf.matmul(x[0], x[1], transpose_b=True) / TEMP_INIT)([norm_v, norm_t])

model = Model([vit_input, text_input], logits)
loss_fn = tf.keras.losses.SparseCategoricalCrossentropy(from_logits=True)
optimizer = tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(LR)

# ----------------------------
# Dummy Data for Use Cases
# ----------------------------
def gen_dummy_batch():
    imgs = tf.random.uniform((BATCH_SIZE, IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE, 3))
    captions = tf.constant(["a photo"] * BATCH_SIZE)
    # positive diagonal labels
    labels = tf.range(BATCH_SIZE)
    return imgs, captions, labels

# ----------------------------
# Training Loop
# ----------------------------
for epoch in range(1, EPOCHS + 1):
    imgs, caps, labels = gen_dummy_batch()
    with tf.GradientTape() as tape:
        sims = model([imgs, caps], training=True)
        loss = loss_fn(labels, sims)
    grads = tape.gradient(loss, model.trainable_variables)
    optimizer.apply_gradients(zip(grads, model.trainable_variables))
    if epoch % 2 == 0:
        tf.print("Epoch", epoch, "Loss", loss)

# ----------------------------
# Example Use Cases
# ----------------------------
imgs, caps, labels = gen_dummy_batch()
sims = model.predict([imgs, caps])
print("Similarity matrix shape:", sims.shape)
print("Top-1 matches:", tf.argmax(sims, axis=1).numpy())

This CLIP-style dual‑encoder pushes Keras into cross‑modal contrastive learning, combining ViTs, Transformer text encoders, patch embeddings, and similarity computation—enabling you to align image/text in a shared embedding space, test similarity, retrieval, and zero‑shot classification with minimal code.
